scripts.build:prepare: bun --filter @dmmarket/frontend build && mkdir -p client && rm -rf client/build && cp -R ../frontend/build client/build && node scripts/generate-assets.js && node scripts/generate-version.js && node scripts/generate-google-client.js
scripts.build: bun run build:prepare && bun build --compile main.js --minify --external mysql --outfile dmmarket-app
scripts.build:windows: bun run build:prepare && bun build --compile --target=bun-windows-x64 main.js --minify --external mysql --outfile dmmarket-app.exe
scripts.build:linux: bun run build:prepare && bun build --compile --target=bun-linux-x64-baseline main.js --minify --external mysql --outfile dmmarket-app-linux
